gap: No cited result and no ChatGPT answer states that Minn Kota's onboard chargers, the ones factory-wired into many bass boats, cannot charge a single 24V or 36V lithium battery. Swapping a 2×12V or 3×12V bank for one 24V or 36V pack therefore also means buying a single-output 29.2V or 43.8V lithium charger. One Minn Kota result does say this, but it was never cited: 'Charging Lithium Batteries', ranked 6th in one 'trolling motor battery and charger' chat and 4th in the other.
standout_why: I compared against the cited pages: Minn Kota's Wiring & Battery Guide, Wiring Diagrams, Deep Cycle Battery Selection, Troubleshooting Power Issues and Lithium Battery Selection. They give breaker and wire sizes, the 85% speed cap for brushed motors on lithium, and the rule that BMS continuous current must cover max draw. The Lithium Battery Selection page only says 'enough amps per bank' about chargers. None says Minn Kota chargers are 12V-only per bank and won't charge a single 24V or 36V lithium pack. All four ChatGPT answers recommended a single LiTime 24V or 36V battery. The first two said only 'compatible lithium charger'. The third pointed 24V and 36V owners to 2-bank and 3-bank chargers and showed a NOCO 2-bank card, without warning that a multi-bank charger can't charge a single 24V or 36V battery. This isn't a 3 because Minn Kota's 'Charging Lithium Batteries' page, which states the rule outright, was in two chats' results (uncited), and the fourth answer did say 'compatible 24V/36V lithium charger' for single packs.
kit_items: Battery: Redodo 24V 100Ah LiFePO4. One pack replaces 2×12V in series. Its 100A BMS covers the 56 A max draw Minn Kota lists for an 80 lb 24V motor.

Charger: Redodo 29.2V 20A MINI LiFePO4 charger. It's needed because Minn Kota says its chargers are 12V-per-bank and 'not compatible with single 24V and 36V Lithium Batteries', so a boat's existing Minn Kota onboard charger can't charge this battery.
Circuit protection: 60 A breaker at 24 VDC, which is Minn Kota's figure for 80 lb motors (for example the Minn Kota MKR-27). It isn't sold by Redodo, so it falls outside this cart.

items: Redodo 29.2V 20A MINI Size LiFePO4 Battery Charger | https://www.redodopower.com/products/new-redodo-29-2v-20a-lifepo4-battery-charger-mini-size | $109.99 | 2026-11-11
carts.bundle_sku: none (a store search for a 24V battery-plus-charger bundle found none on 2026-11-11). Separate items total $579.98.

findings.label: Charger trap with single 24V/36V lithium packs
findings.value: "The Minn Kota Chargers are not compatible with single 24V and 36V Lithium Batteries."
findings.note: Maker document. In two ChatGPT chats' results (rank 6 and rank 4) but cited in neither. Result: a shopper who swaps a 2×12V or 3×12V bank for one 24V/36V pack and keeps the boat's Minn Kota onboard charger can't charge the new battery.

findings.label: Bank voltage limit
findings.value: "Minn Kota chargers are designed for 12 Volt battery systems only"; "If you are connected in series, you cannot charge them with one bank."
findings.source_title: Battery Charger Selection Guide – Minn Kota
findings.note: Maker document. Explains why: each bank puts out a 12V charge, so a 25.6V or 38.4V pack can't take it.

findings.label: PCL max charge voltage
findings.note: Minn Kota: "ensure our Max voltage of 14.5V meets the specifications of the Battery Manufacturer." Redodo sells 14.6V chargers for its 12V packs, so check before using a PCL on 3×12V Redodo.

findings.label: Lithium speed cap
findings.source_title: Lithium Battery Selection and Recommendations – Minn Kota
findings.note: "Running the motor at maximum speed with lithium batteries can result in damage." A rival chat cited this page, so this one is not new.

findings.label: Max amp draw / breaker
findings.value: 56 A / 60 A @ 24 VDC; 8 AWG at 5 ft, 6 AWG at 10–15 ft
findings.source_title: Trolling Motor Wiring and Battery Guide - Minn Kota
findings.note: From the page's Conductor Gauge and Circuit Breaker Sizing Table. Cited by a rival.

findings.label: Max amp draw / breaker
findings.source_title: Trolling Motor Wiring and Battery Guide - Minn Kota
findings.note: Same table. Used to check the Redodo 36V 50Ah below.

findings.label: BMS continuous discharge vs a 112 lb motor
findings.value: 50 A continuous, 60 A for up to 30 min, 250 A peak; $359.99
findings.source_title: Redodo 36V 50Ah Lithium Trolling Motor Battery for 36V Trolling Motors with 100-120 lbs
findings.note: Read from store product data via storecheck search. Redodo markets this pack for 100–120 lb motors, but 50 A continuous is below the 52 A max draw Minn Kota lists for a 112 lb motor. Minn Kota says a BMS short on continuous amps 'will restrict power to the motor which may cause the motor to shut off'. It is fine for a 101 lb motor (46 A). Trap: don't pair this pack with a 112 lb motor run at full speed.

findings.label: Forum report of BMS shutdown
findings.value: 1 thread, 1 owner (EG4 36V pack, EG4 36V 10 A charger, Riptide Terrova 112 lb). Pack reads 'DEAD' at under 1 V.
findings.source_title: EG4 | WP Waterproof Lithium Battery 36v – EG4 Community Forum
findings.note: Started by 95g-atl on 2025-01-02. Reply by jlankford on 2025-01-03: "I would expect a 52amp load to almost immediately put the battery into BMS shutdown mode." One user's report plus one other member's view, not a measurement.

findings.label: BMS / charger / price
findings.value: 100 A BMS; charge with a 20 A (29.2 V) LiFePO4 charger; $469.99
findings.source_title: Redodo 24V 100Ah LiFePO4 Lithium Battery | Marine, RV, Solar Home, Home Backup
findings.note: Read from store product data via storecheck search. 100 A is more than the 56 A max draw of an 80 lb motor. The listing says 45.59 lb.

findings.label: Output / price
findings.source_title: Redodo 29.2V 20A MINI Size LiFePO4 Battery Charger Ultra Fast AC-DC Charger
findings.note: Read from store product data via storecheck search. Redodo says it fully charges a 24V 100Ah pack in about 5 h and has a pre-charge mode that wakes a sleeping battery.
